'''Romi Park''' (Japanese: '''朴璐美''' ''Park Romi''), also known as '''Romi Paku''', is a Korean-Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was born on January 22, 1972 in {{wp|Edogawa, Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Park is most noted for providing the voice of {{an|Brock}}'s younger brother, [[Forrest]]. She also voices various [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. Her most recent role was [[Cyllene]] in the [[Pokémon: Hisuian Snow]] animated web series.
